entries.speaker: Working at the Beef Bowl Shop
entries.en: Working at the beef bowl shop will cause[n]time to pass, but in addition to receiving[n]money, your [stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27] will improve.

entries.speaker: Working at the Beef Bowl Shop
entries.en: Some days the shop will be more crowded than usual.[n]During busier times you will need to remember a lot[n]of orders. Stay calm; if you can make it through the[n]rush, you may earn more money than usual.
